notes.title: Vidya Poker ➡ Update 2.4 ➡ LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]Getting closer to exiting Early Access!!![/h1]


Hey everyone! coolnames comin' at ya with a pretty big content update!
Thank you all for your support during the dev process!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/231685f51a308025cb9156f84ef6af30e30f7be2.gif[/img]
[h2]New Card Back styles to unlock![/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/511b66b9ff753643519e300cde922bfffdccc2f9.gif[/img]
[h2]New 3D menus![/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/1ce905359255f57b6f7b46c34f2bb91de9bce923.png[/img]
[h2]Auto Play!!![/h2]
Vidya Poker can now play itself!
Clicking the 'AUTO' button or pressing 'A' on the keyboard will toggle Auto Play!
Interacting with the cards or the Deal button will exit Auto Play.
Auto Play logic is as follows:[olist]
[*] Deal a new hand!
[*] If dealt winning hand, hold winning cards. Otherwise, hold specific cards for best chance of rewards.
[*] Draw replacement cards!
[*] Celebrate winnings! (timed)
[*] Repeat!
[/olist]
Card selection rules if dealt a non-winning hand are as follows:[olist]
[*] 4 to a Royal
[*] 4 to a Straight Flush
[*] 3 to a Royal
[*] 4 to a Flush
[*] Pair (other than Jacks or Better)
[*] 4 to a Straight
[*] 2 suited Face Cards (Ace, King, Queen, Jack)
[*] 3 to a Straight Flush
[*] 2 Face Cards
[*] 1 Face Cards
[*] WIPE
[/olist]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/cdacbf0f924653f5ecb33e0b39021c1adf437a68.png[/img]
[h2]Automatically have Steam take screenshots![/h2]
When turned on, this feature will capture a screenshot at the end of a winning hand at a x7 (or greater) multiplier or a hand score above Full House.  Perfect for when using Auto Play!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/b3168c3a3967adaf717058701f0efe7c714ab781.png[/img]
[h2]News & Patch notes viewable in-game![/h2]



I think only one last big update is left while still in Early Access.  Here are the main features planned to be implemented:
[list]
[*] New locations to unlock and play in: mountains, ocean+ island, forest, etc!
[*] Graphics quality / performance options!
[*] Multi-language support! Let me know which should be a priority!
[/list]

See ya then!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/9c533432022bb24981cdaa8d87c1b8be028101f6.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]


[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]
[h2]Vidya Poker v2.4[/h2]
[h3]5-11-21[/h3]

[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list]
[*]AUTO PLAY ➡ Toggling Auto Play will have the game play itself autonomously.[/*][*]SCREENSHOTS ➡ Toggling option to automatically capture screenshots in Steam when earning a hand with a 7x win multiplier or a rare score.[/*][*]CARD BACKS ➡ New designs are now available to be unlocked and used.[/*][/list]
[b]INPUT:[/b]
[list]
[*]KEYBOARD ➡ 'A' Key ➡ Toggles Auto Play during poker play.[/*][*]KEYBOARD ➡ 'A' and 'D' Keys ➡ Cycles through selections when in Customization menus.[/*][*]KEYBOARD ➡ Space Bar ➡ Selects item when in Customization menus.[/*][*]MOUSE ➡ Scroll Wheel ➡ Cycles through selections when in Customization menus.[/*][/list]
[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*]WHAT'S NEW ➡ Button now on Main Menu to showcase news and patch release notes.[/*][*]AUTO PLAY ➡ Toggle button under DEAL button during play. A progress bar is shown showing the timer remaining before a new hand is dealt.[/*][*]CUSTOMIZATION ➡ All customization menus are now rendered in 3D and unlocks are presented in unique ways.[/*][*]CUSTOMIZATION ➡ The 'Select' button is now hidden when switching to an already selected Toon or Card.[/*][*]ICONS ➡ New Question Mark icon for 'How to Play' buttons.[/*][*]READABILITY ➡ Added black stroke around Game Type button text during poker play.[/*][*]HIDE POKER UI ➡ Now includes the hiding of all UI elements (except menu button and winning score text).[/*][*]HOW TO PLAY ➡ Instructional information updated to include new features.[/*][/list]
[b]SOUND:[/b]
[list]
[*]Sound now plays when app is not in focus.[/*][/list]
[b]STATS:[/b]
[list]
[*]Special types of '4 of a Kind' scores are no longer added to the '4 OF A KIND' stat. Each is now unique.[/*][/list]
[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*]FIXED ➡ When diamonds are counted after a winning hand, SFX no longer trigger an extra time.[/*][*]FIXED ➡ During gameplay, rotation of Toon is no longer affected by FPS drops.[/*][*]FIXED ➡ All UI elements are no longer 'focusable', preventing inadvertently triggering things when pressing Space Bar.[/*][*]FIXED ➡ Viewing the 'How to Play' menu during poker play is now readable.[/*][*]FIXED ➡ Resetting player stats no longer resets coins, diamonds, nor achievements. Achievement progresses for multiple scores *are* reset.[/*][*]FIXED ➡ After resetting player stats, the player's win/loss streak is reset now.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Vidya Poker ➡ Update 2.3 ➡ LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey Hey!! New visuals and bug fixes!!![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/8d742494ca491d51b9550f2f4428b6716f8184a2.gif[/img]
coolnames here! Still plugin' away on Vidya Poker updates!  When testing this update, I got a pretty decent multiplier goin, and then BAM! got a Full House!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/3e155cf7742e69cda2442672a57e99c62e4f8f31.jpg[/img]
Was pretty lucky!


[h2]Hot Streaks! Cold Streaks!! Multipliers!!![/h2]
New visuals for Hot and Cold Streaks are live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/4689e54364f970c0f3e4d0074c84e1df17bbeda1.gif[/img]
I added some falling transitions to all 3D streak text!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/1a9dac491c799c1af063ce34d5fabba1c5b9eb4f.gif[/img]
The Streak Multiplier text has a constant fire type now, but displays a fire burst when winning another hand and when incrementing to the next multiplier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/fd18852e29eeb40dc84d76ea2f281c17aca9fb8d.gif[/img]
Cold Streak text is now in the game! It is just another subtle visual to add some zazz to the scene when in a Cold Streak.


[h2]New Mouse Cursors![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/8e0bc6f96c72a20353b2e83880d625a7c5e8bf9f.gif[/img]
When playing in a higher resolution window, the larger mouse cursors help find the little guy!


[h2]Bug Fixes![/h2]
With the help from a couple very awesome players, a couple glaring bugs have been fixed!
[list]
[*]Diamonds earned from Hot Streak multipliers were being reported, but not saved correctly.  Diamonds are properly saving now!
[*]A quick player could select a discarded card after clicking the DRAW button. This only caused a visual glitch and did not affect scores or stats.  Now fixed!
[/list]

Any bugs you encounter, please send me a message on the forums or directly so I can fix it!


Thanks so much for your support! I am still working on a mobile release but will be ironing out some further game refinements first!  Next big one will be Graphics Quality settings!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/9c533432022bb24981cdaa8d87c1b8be028101f6.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]


[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]
[h2]Vidya Poker v2.3[/h2]
[h3]3-14-21[/h3]

[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*]HOT STREAK / COLD STREAK ➡ New 3D text & animations for current Hot or Cold Streak status.[/*][*]CURSOR ➡ New larger mouse cursors.[/*][*]PLAYER STATS ➡ 4 OF A KIND bonus hands indented for clarification.[/*][*]HOW TO PLAY ➡ Updated information regarding Keyboard controls.[/*][*]HOW TO PLAY ➡ Updated information about earning Diamonds with Aces and Hot Streaks.[/*]
[/list]
[b]MUSIC:[/b]
[list]
[*]FADE ➡ Music now transitions slowly between tracks when entering/leaving Hot and Cold Streaks.[/*]
[/list]
[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*]FIXED ➡ Bug where extra Diamonds earned during a Hot Streak were not being saved.[/*][*]FIXED ➡ Bug where a player could select discarded/falling cards if quick enough after a DRAW.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Vidya Poker ➡ Major Update 2.2 LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h1]Boom! The first big update for Vidya Poker since Early Access release is now live![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/bcf562b176366d24c47190d8e976ea9b388d39d3.gif[/img]
I Hope you have had fun playing...and with the new options and gameplay tweaks, I hope you will like the game even more :D


[h2]Keyboard Support[/h2]
I started implementing keyboard input support for both the menus and during gameplay. Ever closer to the casino/bartop way to physically play! 
- The Escape key will either toggle the Pause menu or back you out of any sub-menu you are in.
- The 1 through 5 keys will toggle selection of the respective playing card.
- Space/Enter keys will trigger the Deal/Draw button.


[h2]Video Options[/h2]
There are now Video options available to be changed from both the Main Menu as well as when the game is Paused!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/3f3ba4b6b8e3537a24bb67c02dd910c10ba724bc.png[/img]


[h2]Earn more Diamonds and Coins[/h2]
I made some changes to increase how much currency is earned ...that should make playing more fun!
- Hot Streaks now award the player additional Diamonds and Coins using a Multiplier that increases per win while Hot!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/4038862945de3197af7ad7434f2b87ae09a16018.png[/img]
Example:
Hot multiplier = 3
Winning hand payout = 1
Total Diamond payout is 3 x 1 = 3
Total Coin payout is 3 x 25 = 75


- During a Hot Streak, if a winning hand as Aces, the Hot multiplier is increased +1 for the Diamonds calculated. Now Aces always provide an additional bonus no matter the Hot status.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/38fe80afbb2258679e733b74fcc10a8297f127d0.png[/img]
Example:
Hot multiplier = 2
Winning hand payout = 1
Total Diamond payout is 2 x (1 + 1) = 4
Total Coin payout is 2 x 25 = 50


- When not in a Hot Streak, a winning hand with Aces will award the player in Diamonds equal to that of the payout multiplier for that hand.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/e0ea0dfc4d051fde57252baafaefd87946bfc600.png[/img]



That's all Folks! ...for now! Still adding features! (further animations for Hot and Cold streaks, graphics quality selection, etc).  Have fun!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39175154/9c533432022bb24981cdaa8d87c1b8be028101f6.png[/img]



[h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2]
[h2]Vidya Poker v2.2[/h2]
[h3]2-17-21[/h3]

[b]BRANDING:[/b]
[list]
[*]INTRO VIDEO ➡ coolnames video added 😎[/*]
[/list]
[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[list]
[*]ACE HANDS ➡ In non-hot streak, diamond payout = paytable mult[/*][*]HOT STREAK ➡ Multiply Diamond payout with Fire intensity level[/*][*]HOT STREAK ➡ Multiply HOT Multiplier into coin payout[/*][*]HOT STREAK ➡ Winning hand with Aces has +1 Diamond payout[/*]
[/list]
[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*]OPTIONS MENU & PAUSE MENU ➡ Access to Video options in to change Resolution, Fullscreen and Vsync[/*][*]HOT STREAK ➡ Show fire intensity level for payout multiplier[/*][*]MENUS ➡ New Button Icons[/*][*]Version number and username in corner of viewport[/*]
[/list]
[b]INPUT:[/b]
[list]
[*]Keyboard Support ➡ Escape Button ➡ Exit Menu or Toggle Pause Menu[/*][*]Keyboard Support ➡ Space/Enter ➡ Deal/Draw Button[/*][*]Keyboard Support ➡ 1 - 5 Keys ➡ Card selection[/*]
[/list]
